title: A Rivergate for the Compass
author: C. M. Eriksen
blurb: Ansel Delacroix, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
